test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

A company can / make money by / obtain resources / more affordably.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect form of the verb "**obtain**."
 
• To maintain parallelism with the verb "**make**," the correct form should be "**obtaining**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**make money by obtaining resources**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"A company can make money by **obtaining resources** more affordably."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "make money by,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **3: "A company can,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "more affordably."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
